name: Pasura Industries Limited
about: Arunjyothi Bio Ventures Limited provides co-packing services in India. It serves beverage and non-carbonated water industries. The company was formerly known as Century 21st Portfolio Limited and changed its name to Arunjyothi Bio Ventures Limited in 2014. Arunjyothi Bio Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
